data: NVIDIA's revenue grew from $26,974 million in fiscal 2023 (year ended January 29, 2023) to $130,497 million in fiscal 2025 (year ended January 26, 2025). That is an increase of $103,523 million, or about 383.8%, meaning revenue in fiscal 2025 was roughly 4.8 times the fiscal 2023 level. For context, fiscal 2024 revenue was $60,922 million, so the growth came in two steps: about 125.9% from fiscal 2023 to fiscal 2024, and about 114.2% from fiscal 2024 to fiscal 2025.
